authentication.supportScope: actor_type=ADMIN_STAFF AND actor_id=current_admin_staff_id, enforced in SQL

cursor.meaning: exclusive position after the last returned row

action.pattern: ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen; exact match

targetType.pattern: ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen; exact match

to.semantics: inclusive UTC calendar date, implemented as exclusive midnight of the next day

query.validation: Unknown, duplicate, malformed, or invalid fields and reversed date ranges are rejected.

auditItem.reason: string|null; raw reason only for recognized ADMIN_STAFF event names
auditItem.result: SUCCESS for the explicitly recognized transactional ADMIN_STAFF emitters; otherwise null

privacy: No raw JSON passthrough; unknown fields, nested values and wrong scalar types are dropped.
Unknown event reasons are null. No joins to user PII or financial tables occur.
Malformed or legacy JSON yields null safe differences without failing the page.

Result is SUCCESS only for known admin.login, admin.logout, admin.reauth, users.status, and sessions.revoke-all events that are written in the same transaction as their successful action; all other event results remain null.
not_implemented: independent result/history schema or historical result backfill for unknown event kinds
